messages.title: 告 Ninefold · The first closed test is open
body: **Nine realms stand between a mortal and the sky. You sit at the foot of the first.**
Ninefold is an idle cultivation game, painted in ink. Qi gathers on its own, even with your phone shut, and every choice is the same good problem: grow stronger now, or climb.
**What waits for you**
境 Nine realms and nine heavens, each with its own painted landscape
獸 Thirty-six beasts to hunt, a warden at the end of every realm, and Dragons above the summit
職 Gear in five ranks, six schools, and fifteen classes you become by what you wear
洞 A cave that grows while you sleep, a vault that opens every few hours, a tower with no top
樂 Its own music, a road full of strangers, and a new quarry every week
**One promise above the rest: nothing is ever taken away for being away.** Close it for a week and your cultivator is further along, never behind. And losing a fight costs nothing, ever.
Play it the way you would if nobody was watching. Then tell us what confused you, what annoyed you, and what made you come back.

messages.title: 盾 Fair play: sealed saves, verified boards
body: A tester opened his save file, edited his way to the ninth realm and told us straight away. Thank you: that is exactly the kind of report this test needs.

**What happened on the boards:** nothing. The server refused every edited sync and kept him at the last point he had honestly reached. That is how the rankings are built: every climb is measured against how much real time has passed on the server, so an edited save, a moved clock or a forged copy never gets on.

**What changes today:** your save is now sealed on your device. It reads as noise rather than text, and the game notices when a save was changed by hand. An edited save still plays, because nothing is ever taken away, but the Rankings screen says plainly that it will not be ranked.
Your existing save is sealed the next time the game saves; you do not have to do anything. Copies you took before still restore.
Found a way onto the boards you did not earn? That is the bug we most want to hear about, in {#bugs}.

messages.title: 筆 Dev log #1 · Ninefold gets its face
body: The last stretch before the first testers was about how Ninefold looks, sounds and feels. The game underneath is the same. The face is new.
fields: 標 A logo
A gold brush ensō with the seated cultivator inside it. It is now the app icon, the splash when the game opens, the browser tab and this server.
樂 Its own music
Three tracks made for the game: two to cultivate to, one for the hunt. The music follows you from screen to screen and crosses between tracks without a gap. Its volume is its own, in the ≡ menu.
貴 A premium finish
Every card is mounted like a painting, with gold corners and a lacquer fill. Titles, numbers and buttons take the logo's lettering. The PC version wears the logo down its side.
書 A guide for everything
{#guides} holds fourteen posts, one per system, each with the real screen it explains. The classes have a chart of their own.
修 Fixes
The end of a fight scrolls on short screens and zoomed browsers. The day shows in the header again. *Report a bug* now sits in the ≡ menu.
▸ Next
The wardens and the heavens get their own music. After that, whatever you find. Tell us in {#bugs} and {#ideas}.

messages.title: 筆 Dev log #2 · The Workshop is coming
body: The next update is the biggest since the test opened, and it began with you. Raziel asked for jobs like the ones in Dao of the Endless Sky. Here is what we built, before it goes in, so you can tell us what to change.
fields: 業 The Workshop

A new tab from realm 2: seven crafts you level from 1 to 99. Gather herbs and ore, render the parts of the beasts you hunt, forge metal, tools and the gear you choose. Alchemy follows at realm 5, Sigil Writing at 6, Arrays at 7.
攜 What it is for

An elixir and a sigil carried into your next warden, heart demon or vault gate. A win spends what took part, a loss keeps it. Forged gear is the piece you choose, and it melts back into metal, never qi.
守 What it never does

It keeps working 12 hours after you close the game and loses nothing. Nothing it makes raises your qi rate. We played the whole climb with it and without it: it lands within two days either way. A second road, not a shortcut.
畫 Painted
Every herb, ore, metal, elixir, sigil, array and tool is painted in the same ink as the beasts, and each craft has its own scene. The pictures below are the real game.
圍 The drive, repriced

Raziel was right: the drive cost too much. Its price was a share of the layer you stood on, so late in the climb a drive of fifty ate more than a day of qi to save a few minutes of tapping. With this update it costs time instead: one minute of your own gathering per kill, so fifty kills are fifty minutes of qi in every realm. A beast from an earlier realm costs a quarter of that, which puts the bestiary and the fate bars within a drive's reach. It pays what the same kills by hand would (the same material, record and drops), and fighting one at a time stays free.
議 Tell us
What would you change before it lands? Everything is open. Answer in *業 The Workshop: tell us what you think*, pinned in {#ideas}.
謝 Thanks
To Raziel, for the jobs thread and for the word about the drive. Every post in {#bugs} and {#ideas} is read.

messages.title: 筆 Update · Less clicking
body: Hunting was too much clicking for an idle game. This update is about that, and it started with two posts in {#ideas}.
fields: 自 Auto-hunt

Win a fight and press Auto: the game keeps hunting that beast for you while it's open. It stops if you lose, if you switch away, or when you press Stop. Every kill counts exactly like one you clicked.
再 Again
Collect and fight the same beast again in one tap, right next to Collect.
盡 Max
Above the upgrades, switch from ×1 to Max and one tap buys every level you can afford.
鍵 On a PC
Space skips a fight, Enter collects, R goes again, A starts Auto, Esc closes, 1 to 7 change tab. Clicking outside a window closes it too.
譯 Names next to the characters
The fight screen names both sides in English, every 材 says material, and gear stats say what they are. On a PC a character's note opens when you hover over it.
謝 Thanks
To rekaris, for both posts. That's exactly the kind of feedback that changes the game, so keep it coming.

messages.title: 筆 Update · Melting, Auto and the drive
body: A balance fix, the morning after Auto went in. It found a hole that was already there.
fields: 拆 Melting

Melting gear now pays qi out of an allowance that refills as you gather, open or closed, up to six hours of your own gathering. Past it, a piece melts into 材 material instead. With Auto on, melting had become faster than cultivating, and the whole climb ran about three times too fast.
自 Auto
Auto opens for a beast once it's Known, at 10 kills. Again works on every beast, as before.
圍 The drive
Four times cheaper: fifteen seconds of your own gathering per kill. It's the way to hunt while the game is closed.
器 A fix
On a PC, hovering a piece you wear no longer makes it jump away from the mouse.
▸ Nothing is taken
Your qi, material and gear stay exactly as they are, and the allowance starts full.
謝 Thanks
To rekaris again, for three posts in one morning that found all of this.

messages.title: 筆 Update · Your ideas, one by one
body: Every post in {#ideas} and {#bugs} from the last two days, read and answered. Most of them are in this update, and the rest are being measured before they go in.
fields: 鎖 Locks and 套 Loadouts

Lock a piece and nothing melts it, fuses it or pushes it out of a full chest. Save what you wear as a loadout, up to three, and put it all back on with one tap. A loadout is named after the class it makes.
職 Schools at a glance

Every gear icon carries its school's seal in the corner, the chest filters by school, and each beast shows which school every piece it leaves belongs to. On a PC a piece's sheet opens with every effect shown.
序 Order the hunt
A switch over the beasts: Next mark, Strongest or Most material. Your device remembers it.
精 Two new marks
精 Seasoned at 1,000 kills of a beast and 絕 Peerless at 5,000. Each pays that beast alone +10% 材 material and +2 points of drop chance.
鑰 The Realm Key
Forge one in the Workshop from the third realm and it opens 秘境 the secret realm's door at once. The door takes one key a day.
悟道 Cards with numbers
Every card now says what it does in your own numbers before you take it. And the luck cards were weak late on, so luck now lifts 地 Earth and 天 Heaven pieces more than 玄 Mystic ones.
物 Names in the Workshop
Tap or hover a material in a recipe to see what it is and which craft makes it, with a button that takes you there.
寶匠 Treasure Smith
Its allowance for melting refills 30% faster, and what melts into material past it gives 30% more.
🐞 Fixed
Clicking another window no longer ends 入定 sitting while the game is still on your screen. The "held for review" note on the rankings says plainly that it isn't a strike.
▸ Nothing is taken
Your qi, material, gear and saves are exactly as they were.
謝 Thanks
To rekaris, for ten posts that shaped almost all of this, and to everyone testing. Keep them coming.

It shows every shape under its school, drawn in your realm's metal, marks the pieces you're wearing, and says what each school and each of the fifteen classes gives.
Two rows of filters on top pick one school, one place on the body, or both: tap 運 Fortune and Ring and you see the two Fortune rings and Fortune's five classes. No numbers changed.

messages.title: 筆 Update · Five fixes from your posts
body: Thanks to rekaris for testing the last update within hours! Five things came out of it, and all five are in now:
· A beast at 100 kills no longer hides as finished: it stays in the list on its way to 精 Seasoned and 絕 Peerless.
· Loadouts can be renamed with ✎.
· Hover or tap a school seal on the hunt list or in the bestiary and it says which school it is.
· On a computer the chest filters wrap onto a new line instead of hiding past the edge.
· Every line of a piece now sits at the top of its sheet, beside power and qi.
No numbers changed. Keep the reports coming in {#bugs} and {#ideas}, they make the game better every day.

messages.title: 筆 Update · Change your Enlightenment cards
body: rekaris made the case that in a game you keep for months, a card you picked in week one shouldn't lock your build for good. Fair, and now it doesn't.

**悟道 Your Enlightenment cards** (in the menu, or the line on the home screen) shows every card you've taken. Tap *Change* on any of them to see the other two it came with and what each would do for you, then tap twice to trade.

It costs your own qi: half a day of gathering for your newest card, half a day more for each card taken after it. We measured it first: across a whole climb your card choices are worth about a day, so this is for playing the build you want, not for racing.

Also in this update: a few fixes from a review of the code. Loadouts now stay on screen when you've taken everything off, melting can never touch a locked piece, and the school filters in the chest show up even when all your pieces are from one school. Thanks to rekaris, and to everyone in {#ideas} and {#bugs}!

messages.title: 筆 Update · Older forges, faster melting, deep marks everywhere
body: A round of your ideas, nearly all from rekaris and Raziel. Thank you both, and thanks to everyone posting in the forums.

**鑄 Forge any realm you've reached.** A row of realms sits above the Gear list in Forging. *Now* is your realm and the one before, like before, and any realm you've reached shows its own pieces. A search looks through all of them.

**拆 Melting refills faster.** The allowance now refills at 37.5% of your gathering, up from 25%. Over a whole climb Auto gets about five days back and still stays a little behind someone who checks in every hour.
**精 Deep marks count everywhere.** Every 精 Seasoned and 絕 Peerless mark also adds +0.5% 材 material from every beast now, so finishing old beasts pays off.
**造化 Creation turns drop chance into luck.** Once every kill drops a piece, drop chance had nothing left to do. Now it becomes luck: +0.1 for every 10 points, up to +0.5.
**示 Missing lines show as +0.** A piece's sheet now also lists the lines the piece you wear has and this one doesn't, with a dashed red edge, so it can't pass for a strict upgrade.
**期 The rankings open on This Week.** Everybody starts level on Monday, so it's the board a new player can win in their first week.

Also: the refining text was wrong. The levels follow what you wear: a new piece you put on takes the higher of the two levels, and the one you take off keeps the lower. That's how it always worked; now it says so.

messages.title: 筆 Update · A second piece, a tree that lasts, and a lot of small fixes
body: A big round of your feedback plus a full audit of the game. Thank you, rekaris and Raziel, and everyone testing.

**造化 Creation gives a second piece.** Once every kill drops a piece, your drop chance is now the chance of a *second* piece from the same kill (up to 50%), instead of the small bit of luck it gave this morning. More pieces means more to fuse, which is where the best gear comes from.

**道 The Path lasts longer.** The secret realm's shrines were handing out almost every Path point in the game, so the whole tree was bought in two days. Shrines now pay up to 3 points per realm you've reached, then pay qi like a spring. The last node of each branch (萬劍 Ten Thousand Swords, 化境 Transcendence, 造化 Creation) opens at the sixth realm. **Anything you already bought stays yours.**
**習 Familiarity explains itself.** Tap the dots on a recipe to see what each of its five marks gives and how many makes are left.
**Fixes**
· A new cultivator keeps their 56 qi until their first purchase, instead of watching the bar eat it.
· Arts show their English names on the Path, every rank chip in the chest is named, and the stele reads in English.
· The stele and the credits close with ✕ or Esc.
· On small phones the day count no longer gets cut off, and the ≡ button no longer covers prices when you scroll.
· The save panel says what is true whether you play as a guest or signed in.
· Gear power shows two decimals, the bar says when a warden is waiting, and the Tower shows how much stronger a floor is instead of a misleading 2%.
· The card-trade price and the tribulation counts now read the same everywhere.

messages.title: 筆 Update · Three things that were hard to see
body: A small one. Thank you all for testing and for every screenshot you send.
**塔 The Tower on a computer.** The tower drawing and the floor you're about to climb now sit side by side, so the 登 Climb button is on the first screen instead of below it. Phones are unchanged.

**龍骸 Dragon-scale gear reads again.** The realm-8 pieces were red on red inside a red Heaven frame, and on a phone the sword looked like a smudge. The metal is lighter, the scales are drawn light, and each piece has a dark outline.
**指 The guide's arrow stays out of the way.** On small phones the arrow pointing at your first purchase could sit on top of the ×1 / MAX buttons. It now finds a clear spot.

Coming next: luck that lifts the rolls on your gear, not only the rank, and a weekly quarry that pays at least four hours of your own gathering. Both touch the ranked server, so they go out together once it's updated.

messages.title: 筆 Update · Luck that lifts your rolls, and a quarry worth hunting
body: Thank you, rekaris, for saying out loud that luck felt underwhelming late on. You were right, and here is what changed.

**運 Luck now lifts the roll, not only the rank.** Once every drop was 天 Heaven, luck had nothing left to do. Now your luck also raises where a drop's lines can land: at luck ×2 the best roll goes from 1.15 to about 1.23 of its base, and it tops out at 1.35. The first luck counts the most. Fusing still goes higher (up to 1.5), so fusion stays where the very best gear comes from.

**期 The week's quarry is worth hunting again.** Its first kill each week paid qi from the quarry's own realm, so late in the climb it paid almost nothing. It now pays at least **four hours of your own gathering**, once a week. The hunt band shows the exact amount before you fight.
· The ranked server now counts melting properly, so heavy Auto melters are never held back.
· The ranked server knows about the new quarry payout, so taking it never holds a save for review.

messages.title: 筆 Dev log #4 · Fewer taps, clearer screens
body: Your quality-of-life call got exactly the answers we hoped for. Thank you, rekaris, for the long and careful posts, and thank you to everyone testing.
We also played the game ourselves and counted every tap: a two-minute check-in took 31 to 53. This update is about cutting that down.
fields: 歸 Coming back

The return screen now lists everything that is waiting for you: ripe beds, an open vault, a heart demon, someone on the road, Path points you can actually spend, better gear in your chest, a tower floor you can take. Each line takes you there. If the workshop stopped or waited for something while you were away, it says what and for how long. Tabs carry a small dot when something there is ready.
一 One tap where there were many

· 洞天 Cave: *Take all and plant again*
· 修 *Buy all*, and 爐 pills ×Max
· 器 *Wear all upgrades* and *Fuse all groups*
· 塔 *Next floor* straight from a won fight (R)
· 圍 *Drive again*, or as many as your qi pays for
· 自 *Auto* straight from a beast's row
· 閉關 The seclusion door shuts again by itself after a demon falls
篩 Finding gear

Both of these came from rekaris in the quality-of-life thread. Drops name the slot beside the piece (*Laurel · Crown*). The chest has a third filter row, by lines: pick several and only pieces with all of them show, and you can save up to three filters. A better drop says so on the fight result, with a *Wear it* button. Your filters, melt rank and workshop choices are remembered on your device.
入定 Sitting, explained
A chip shows how deep you are sitting and how long is left, and a sitting now lasts **30 minutes** instead of 15. When it ends, the screen says what starts the next one and offers 坐 *Sit again*.
業 The workshop

Every familiarity mark now gives something on every recipe: 10% faster at 25 makes, then 1 in 10 comes out twice (or 10% faster again for gear and tools), and on from there. Each recipe made 2,000 times makes its whole craft 1% faster, up to 15%. Alchemy, Sigil Writing and Arrays open at their realm, **or sooner** once Herb Gathering, Vein Delving or Forging reaches 40. A craft that isn't open yet shows its recipes greyed, so you can plan for it.
道 The Path and the hunt

The last node of each branch (萬劍 Ten Thousand Swords, 化境 Transcendence, 造化 Creation) now opens at the **fifth** realm instead of the sixth. Each 精 Seasoned and 絕 Peerless mark adds **+1%** material from every beast (it was +0.5%).
🐞 Fixed

· A piece's sheet compared it unrefined against your refined one, so a real upgrade could read as weaker. It now reads the piece as it would be once worn.
· Familiarity no longer promises that gear or tools come out twice.
· A shrine that has given this realm's Path points now says it pays qi.
· Number keys no longer change tab behind the vault or the cards. Esc and Enter close the return screen and notes, and 1 and 2 pick a vault door.
· Small buttons on phones are easier to hit.
守 What stays the same
We measured all of this over the whole climb: the biggest change in anyone's pace is about a day, nothing is taken for being away, and losing a fight still costs nothing.

messages.title: 筆 Update · Fixes from your reports
body: A round of fixes, almost all from rekaris's reports overnight. Thank you, and keep them coming!
And thank you, rekaris, for the long answer under 深 *Deeper hunts*. It is shaping the design, and the polls stay open all week.
fields: 塔 The tower

A floor's qi no longer depends on what you wear. It pays six hours of your gathering (counted without gear) from your realm's warden floor up, and each floor below that pays 20% less. Only 天師 Celestial Master adds to it. The floor card says exactly what the next floor pays, and swapping loadouts after a climb no longer risks your ranking. 套 Loadouts
A piece a loadout uses stays locked until you take it out of the loadout, so melting can't break a loadout by accident.
▲ Upgrades
▲ and *Wear all upgrades* now only mark a piece that is at least as good on every line you wear, so they never suggest losing a line you built for.

· Filter the hunt list by the slot and school a beast leaves (Fortune + Ring)

messages.title: 泉 Update · New ways to earn qi
body: Two new sources of qi that ask you to choose and to fight, and a tower that no longer pays half a realm in one sitting. Thank you rekaris and speculaether for the conversation that led here, and for every report this week.
fields: 秘境 The secret realm's rooms

The spring now fills while the door is shut, 4 minutes of your gathering an hour, up to a day. Each reward room offers its share three ways: 泉 drink it now, 香 burn it as incense for half as much again over time (+30% gathering while it burns, away or not), or a third door: 道, a piece of gear, a craftsman's box of herbs and ore, or a trail for the Platform.
擂台 The Platform

From the fourth realm, on 塔 Trials. Three challengers a week at ×1.3, ×1.8 and ×2.5 your power, paying 2, 4 and 6 hours of your gathering, once each. The week's temper makes them stronger unless your stance or an art answers it. The dice are set for the week, so the same build meets the same fight: change something to win. Losing costs nothing, and it is never on Auto.
塔 The tower

Floors above your realm's warden now pay a little less each, never under 3 hours, so a first big climb is still a reward but no longer half a realm at once. The floor card says exactly what the next floor pays.
氣 Qi pieces
The qi bend now climbs with you: its ceiling rises from ×1.38 to ×1.52 as you open layers, and each realm's own qi pieces still count instead of doing nothing past the third realm.
套 Loadouts
Keep up to five loadouts now, up from three. Their pieces already cost chest places to keep, so more of them is yours to choose.
註 Notes and seals
Tap any gear line for what it does, its cap, how it bends and the formula. Forged pieces show their school in the workshop.
榜 Rankings
The rankings screen says why a save is not ranked, instead of a plain "Not synced yet".

messages.title: 塔 Update · A fair tower, and pills worth making
body: One update for everything you reported this morning. Thank you rekaris and speculaether for pushing on the tower until it was right, and for every post this week.
fields: 塔 The tower

Every floor now pays a fixed sum of qi that depends on the floor alone: the same for everyone, whatever your realm, your gathering or your gear, and whenever you beat it. Floors 1 to 61 pay 8.9M each, so the floors you clear the day the tower opens are worth two or three layers of the fifth realm. Higher floors never pay less: floor 70 pays 69M, floor 100 38.1B, and floor 121 and every floor above it 1.29T. There is no reason to wait, strip or buy gathering first: climb as high as you can, as soon as you can. Only 天師 Celestial Master adds 25%. Floors you have already beaten stay yours.
丹符 Pills and sigils

A pill or a sigil is now about an hour of work, herbs and parts included, and pays the experience of an hour, so the hours to level 99 do not change. Every recipe lists its numbers: how much harder you strike or how much less you take, what it is at Heaven rank, and how it fades in a fight above its realm. What you already made stays in your pouch.
攜 Up the tower

An elixir and a sigil you carry can now go up the tower: choose Take up on the floor's card. A won floor spends whichever took part; a lost one keeps both. A pill made for your realm is worth a floor or two, the 九轉 Nine-Turn Pill at the ninth realm about five.
金剛 The Vajra
Its half again now reaches 擂台 the Platform too: the three challengers pay 3, 6 and 9 hours of your gathering instead of 2, 4 and 6.
天 Heaven into Heaven

At Heaven, three Heaven pieces you found fuse into one Heaven piece with your fusion quality on top, ×1.5 of a usual roll at most. A piece a fusion made is never fused again, so Fuse all takes each found piece once.
拆 Melting and a full chest

A piece melted past the allowance now gives three times the material, and it grows with your seals and material cards like a kill does. A full chest melts the weakest piece counting its quality too, so of two pieces with the same lines the better one stays.

messages.title: 藏 Fix · Your chest keeps every piece
body: A fix that went out straight away, because the game could lose pieces. We found it in our own audit today, before anyone had to report it.
fields: 藏 The chest

Opening the game could quietly remove pieces from a full chest. A low piece with a chest-slot line counted as 0.9 of a place instead of 1, and leaving 甲匠 the Armourer, changing loadout or buying 空囊 Empty Pouch could leave the chest over its limit, which the next load trimmed. A reload now never takes a piece. We're sorry to anyone who lost pieces this way: we can't bring them back from here, but it can't happen again.
二機 Two devices

Playing one account on two devices (the Android app and Chrome, or a phone and a tablet) could count as a cheat when each device answered a meeting on the road differently. It no longer does: the copy that is behind simply waits.
塔 A line of text
The realm card now says what a tower floor really pays: a fixed sum of qi, the same for everyone.

messages.title: 榜 Fix · Fast honest climbs stay on the boards
body: A fix that went out straight away, because it kept honest players off the rankings. Thank you rekaris for reporting it, twice.
fields: 塔 The tower's qi

Climbing many floors at once and spending what they paid on layers and techniques could read as too fast to the server, and the climb was held for review. Measured again for every way of playing over 120 days. Nobody who plays honestly comes near it, and a clock run three times as fast is still caught.

posts.title: 入門 Start here: your first hour
body: **Ninefold is an idle cultivation game.** Qi gathers on its own, even with the game shut. You spend it to grow stronger, or let it fill the bar and climb.
**Three promises the game keeps**
· Nothing is ever taken away for being away. Close it for a week and you come back further along.
· Losing a fight costs nothing. Not qi, not material, not a level.
· Nothing resets. Every realm adds something and keeps everything you had.
fields: ▸ The guide in the game walks you through this

1. Spend the qi your master left you on an upgrade.
2. Win your first fight: the rat.
3. Spend the 材 material it drops on 妖丹 Beast Cores.
4. Kill the same beast ten times, for its 熟 Known mark.
5. Fill the ninth layer, beat the realm's warden, and break through.
Played straight through, the first realm takes about a quarter of an hour.
▸ The characters
Open ≡ Menu → *What the characters mean*. Any character with a dotted line under it says its name when you tap it.
▸ Every other guide
One post on installing, then one per system in the order the game opens them. Ask your questions inside the post they are about.
▸ Found a problem?
≡ Menu → *Report a bug*, or open a post in {#bugs}.

posts.title: 裝 Installing on Android: two ways
body: **Two ways to put Ninefold on an Android phone.** Both are the same game. Pick one and stay with it, because each keeps its own save.
**Way 1 · Install it from Chrome** (recommended)
1. Open **https://hyoddougamer-dev.github.io/ninefold/** in **Chrome**. If Discord opened it in its own browser, tap ⋮ → *Open in Chrome*.
2. Tap ⋮ at the top right → **Install app**. On some phones it reads *Add to Home screen*.
3. Tap **Install**. Ninefold appears on your home screen, opens full screen and updates itself.
**Way 2 · The APK, in a zip**
1. In Chrome, download **[ninefold-android.zip](https://hyoddougamer-dev.github.io/ninefold/ninefold-android.zip)** (17 MB).
2. Tap **Open** when it finishes, or find it in Files → Downloads. Tap **ninefold.apk** inside.
3. Android asks once: tap **Settings**, turn on **Allow from this source**, go back.
4. Tap **Install**, then **Open**.
Installed? Your first hour is in *入門 Start here*, right below.
fields: ⓘ Is the APK safe?

It is our own test build, and the game inside it is the same web game as Way 1. It is not on Google Play, so Android calls it an *unknown app* and asks you to allow the source: that is expected for a test build. You can turn *Allow from this source* off again once it is installed. Only ever take a Ninefold APK from the links in this server.
ⓘ Which one should I pick?

Way 1, unless you want a file. It needs no permission, updates itself, and lets you sign in with email so your save follows you to other devices. The APK signs in with email too: type the 6-digit code from the email into the game.
ⓘ Android refuses to install the APK

Since September 2026, Android in Brazil, Indonesia, Singapore and Thailand can refuse apps from developers not yet registered with Google, and this test build is not registered yet. Use Way 1: it installs no APK of ours, so it is not affected.
ⓘ Still stuck?
Post in {#bugs} with your phone model, your Android version and a screenshot of where it stops.
▸ iPhone
Open the game in Safari → Share → *Add to Home Screen*. Same game, same promises.

posts.title: 氣 Qi, layers and the nine realms
body: Qi gathers at the full rate whether you are here or not, all night, with the phone shut.

**Sitting.** With the game open, gathering deepens up to three times as fast after a few minutes, for half an hour (more with 神 the Spirit branch of the Path). The screen shows how long is left. Coming back to the game starts a new sitting, and so does 坐 Sit again on 修 Cultivate once one has passed. A bonus for being there, never a cost for leaving.

**Layers.** Qi fills the bar, and a full bar opens a layer by itself. Nine layers make a realm. At the ninth, the realm's 守 warden comes out. Beat it, and 突破 Break through takes the next realm. Only you press it, never the clock.
**The trade.** Qi you spend on upgrades stops filling the bar. Choosing between the two is the whole game.
fields: ▸ The four upgrades

劍訣 Sword Technique: power
功法 Cultivation Method: qi per second
吐納 Breathwork: qi per second
妖丹 Beast Cores: power, bought with 材 material, not qi
盡 Buy all buys every level you can pay for, cheapest first
▸ 滿 Full
Each realm holds so many levels of each upgrade. 滿 means this one is at its cap for now. Climb to hold more.
▸ 悟道 Enlightenment cards

Every breakthrough offers three cards and you keep one. You can change your mind later: *Your Enlightenment cards* (in the menu, or the line on the home screen) trades any card for one of the other two it came with. It costs your own qi, half a day of gathering for the newest card and half a day more for each card further back, and asks you to tap twice.
▸ The nine realms
練氣 Qi Refining · 築基 Foundation · 金丹 Golden Core · 元嬰 Nascent Soul · 化神 Spirit Severing · 煉虛 Void Refining · 合體 Unity · 大乘 Great Vehicle · 渡劫 Tribulation

posts.title: 狩 Hunting, the Record and Beast Cores
body: Beasts wait on the 狩 Hunt screen. Fight them whenever you like, as often as you like, for nothing. The percentage on each is your odds.
A fight is settled the moment you press, then plays back round by round. **Win** and you collect 材 material, sometimes a piece of gear. **Lose** and nothing is taken. Come back stronger.
Material is the second currency. Qi cannot buy it and waiting cannot earn it: it falls off beasts. It buys 妖丹 Beast Cores, and from the third realm a warden will not fall without them.
fields: ▸ 錄 The Record: every kill counts for ever

見 **Seen** at 1 kill: the first sight of a beast pays qi.
熟 **Known** at 10 kills: +2% 材 material from everything.
通 **Mastered** at 100 kills: +2% power.
精 **Seasoned** at 1,000 and 絕 **Peerless** at 5,000 kills of one beast: that beast alone pays +10% 材 material and +2 points of drop chance for each, and +1% 材 material from every beast.
▸ 序 Order and 職 schools

A switch over the list orders the beasts by the next mark, the strongest first, or the most material first, and your device remembers it. Only the next-mark order folds a finished beast away; the other two keep it in its place. Under the switch, **Leaves** filters the list by the place and the school of the pieces a beast leaves: 運 Fortune and 戒 Ring shows the beasts that leave a fortune ring. Each piece a beast leaves shows the seal of its school and where it is worn (Laurel · Crown), so you can see who drops a 運 Fortune crown. A beast you know has 自 Auto on its row.
▸ 緣 The bond
Every win fills a beast's bond. The tenth leaves a piece for certain, a rank above the best that beast has given you, and the bond starts again.
▸ 圍 Drive

Buy many kills of a beast you already know at once, instead of tapping for each. Each kill costs fifteen seconds of your own gathering, and a quarter of that on a beast from an earlier realm. The last row drives as many as your qi pays for, and the result offers 再 Drive again. It's the way to hunt while the game is shut; with the game open, 自 Auto hunts for free.
▸ 期 The week's quarry

One beast each week pays double material, and its first kill that week pays a fixed sum of qi read off your realm: the same for everyone in the realm, whatever you wear. The hunt band shows the sum before you fight. It moves every Monday.

posts.title: 器 Gear: ranks, sets, classes and refining
body: From the second realm, beasts leave gear. Tap a piece in your chest to wear it. **Six places:** 劍 Weapon, 袍 Robe, 冠 Crown, 靴 Boots, 珮 Talisman, 戒 Ring.
**Five ranks:** 凡 Common, 靈 Spirit, 玄 Mystic, 地 Earth, 天 Heaven. The rank multiplies every line on a piece. Lines are percentages, so an old piece stays good.
Gear power has no ceiling. Qi from gear has one, and it rises as you climb, so each realm's own qi pieces still count.
fields: ▸ 系 Sets
Wear several pieces from one realm and its lineage pays on top.
▸ 職 Classes
Every line belongs to a school: 劍 Sword, 氣 Qi, 運 Fortune, 體 Body, 器 Artificer, 法 Arts. Wear three pieces of one school and its class wakes. Two schools together make a pair class.
▸ 譜 Which piece is which school

The school goes with the shape, never the metal: a Mortal Iron Sword and an Ascendant Sword are both 劍 Sword. In the order weapon, robe, crown, boots, talisman, ring:
**劍 Sword:** Sword, Saber, Crescent, Spear, Trident · Vest, Lamellar, Breastplate · Visor, Dragon Head · Leather Boots, Greaves · Pendant · Plain Ring, Power Ring
**氣 Qi:** Fan · Robe, Winged Robe · Band, Hairpin, Diadem · Bare Feet, Tabi · Charm, Censer · Topaz, Ringed Star
**運 Fortune:** Scythe · Cloak · Laurel · Sandals, Walkers · Medal, Orb · Amethyst, Emerald
**體 Body:** Twin Hooks · Pauldrons · Horned Helm · Iron Boots · Bone Charm · Frost Ring
**器 Artificer:** no weapon · Mantle · Bone Crown · Fur Boots · Scroll, Orb Wand · Spiral Ring
**法 Arts:** Staff · Kimono · Ritual Crown · Wind Foot · Beads · Flame Ring
▸ 鎖 Locks and 套 Loadouts

Lock a piece from its sheet and nothing melts or fuses it, and a full chest leaves it alone. Save what you wear as a loadout (five at most), name it with ✎, and put it all back on with one tap; saving locks its pieces, and a loadout's piece stays locked until it is out of the loadout. Every piece shows its school's seal in the corner. The chest filters by place (or only 鎖 Locked pieces), by school and by lines (a piece must carry every line you pick), and keeps up to eight filters you name.
▸ 煉器 Refining

Material makes a piece you wear better, for ever. No top level. Put on a new piece and it takes the higher of the two levels, and the piece you take off keeps the lower, so nothing you pour in is ever wasted. A ▲ is read the same way: a piece is compared as it would be once worn, levels and all, and it is ▲ only if it is at least as good on every line the worn piece has. ▲ **Wear all upgrades** puts every ▲ on at once. A piece that holds refining levels is never taken by the bulk melt, a fusion or a full chest; only its own sheet can melt it.
▸ 煉 Fusing and 拆 Melting

From the third realm, three of a kind fuse into one of the rank above, and 煉 **Fuse all groups** does every group in one tap. At 天 Heaven, three Heaven pieces you found fuse into one Heaven piece with your fusion quality on top (×1.5 of a usual roll at most), and a piece a fusion made is never fused again, so Fuse all takes each found piece once. Anything you will not wear melts into qi, up to an allowance that refills as you gather (six hours of your own gathering at most); past it, a piece melts into 材 material instead.

posts.title: 職 Classes: what you wear is who you become
body: Ninefold has no class menu. **Every piece of gear belongs to a school**, by the line it leads with, and what you wear decides who you are.
· **3 pieces** of one school wake it.
· **5 pieces** bring it to its full.
· **3 and 3** of two schools wake both, and together they make one of **fifteen named classes**, each with a perk no school has.
Changing class is changing clothes. It costs nothing, and you can go back whenever you like. So every piece that drops is also a question: who are you becoming?
The item sheet tells you before you wear anything: *Wearing it makes you a Vajra*, or *ends your Wanderer*. The 器 Gear screen shows your class and how many pieces the next step needs.

posts.title: 道 The Path, Keystones, Stances and Arts
body: **道 points** come from climbing: one for every three layers, two for every warden, and more from the heart demon and the Bestiary. They are spent on the tree in 道 the Path.

The tree has three branches, 劍 the Sword, 神 the Spirit and 運 Fortune, with gold bridges between them. Tap a node to read it before you take it. The last node of each branch (萬劍 Ten Thousand Swords, 化境 Transcendence, 造化 Creation) opens at the fifth realm.
fields: ▸ 樞 Keystones
From the fourth realm: three nodes that take something away to pay for what they give. Each is stronger than the node beside it, and each closes a door.
▸ 勢 Stances
Always on. You hold the stance of every realm you have reached, and choose which one you fight in. It changes every round of every fight.
▸ 法 Arts
Three in an order, one firing each round, then looping. Every warden gives up its own art when it falls.
▸ 造化 Creation

The last node of 運 Fortune: every beast leaves a piece. From then on your drop chance is the chance of a second piece from the same kill (up to 50%), so drop chance lines still count and feed 煉 fusion.

posts.title: 洞天 The Cave and 秘境 the Secret Realm
body: **洞天 The Cave** (second realm). Three beds. Plant 材 material and it ripens into qi over real hours. A ripe bed waits for you for ever. It is the one thing that grows while the game is shut, and it pays for coming back to pick it. 收 **Take all and plant again** takes every ripe bed and sows the same herb back, in one tap.
**秘境 The Secret Realm** (third realm). A door opens every few hours. Seven rooms, and every other room is a guardian a realm above you. Nothing is carried in, so losing takes nothing back.

**泉 The spring** fills while the door is shut: four minutes of your gathering for every hour, a day at most (1 h 36 min of gathering when full). The rooms between the guardians share it, the deeper ones more (10, 20, 30 and 40% in seven rooms). Each room offers its share three ways, and whichever you take, the room is spent:
fields: ▸ 泉 Drink it now
Its share as qi, at once. For when the next layer is close.
▸ 香 Burn it as incense
Half as much again, slowly: +30% to your standing gathering while it burns, open or shut. One burner, and the next stick waits behind the one burning, a day at most. 修 says how long it has left.
▸ The third door

龕 a 道 point while your realm's shrine share lasts, 爐 a piece of gear, 匣 a craftsman's box (an hour of this realm's herbs and ore for every room past the first, no experience), or 跡 a challenger's trail: the next challenger on 擂台 the Platform begins a tenth down.
▸ Rooms you do not reach
Stay in the spring for next time. A guardian that puts you down takes nothing, those rooms included. One run a day or three, the spring is the same: it fills with time, not with walks.
▸ 鑰 The Realm Key

Forged in the Workshop from the third realm, from two Elder Bronze ingots and 90 材 material. A key opens a shut door at once, and the door takes one key a day. A door opened early finds a spring that has filled less.
▸ 秘境深 The Deeper Vault
From the seventh realm the path goes further: eleven rooms instead of seven, two more guardians, and the deepest rooms in the game behind them.
▸ This week
Each week one herb is worth planting and one room of the vault pays double. It changes every Monday.

posts.title: 業 The Workshop: seven crafts, 1 to 99
body: **The workshop is a second road beside the climb.** Seven crafts, each levelled from 1 to 99. Set it on one thing and it repeats that on its own, while you play and for 12 hours after you close the game. Past 12 hours it simply stands still: nothing is lost for being away.
A craft that is not open yet still shows its recipes, greyed, so you can plan for it.
fields: ▸ 藥 Herb Gathering · 礦 Vein Delving
Realm 2. Herbs from the paths of every realm you have reached, and ore from their veins. They need only time.
▸ 解 Rendering
Realm 2. Kill ten of a common beast (one, for a warden) and the workshop knows what its kind leave behind: a pelt, a fang, a scale. From then on it renders that part for as long as you let it.
▸ 鑄 Forging

Realm 2. Smelt metal from ore, forge a tool for each craft (each step is 5% faster), forge 鑰 Realm Keys that open the secret realm's door (one a day), and forge gear: the piece you choose, in the shape a beast teaches. A forged piece is bound. It cannot be fused, and melting it gives 2 metal back, never qi.
▸ 丹 Alchemy

Realm 5, or sooner at Herb Gathering 40. Elixirs of Mending (2% of your health a round), Guarding (12% less taken) and Might (12% harder), 1.75 times that at 天 Heaven rank, for every realm, and three rare ones. A pill is about an hour of work, its herbs and parts included, and pays the experience of an hour. Each Alchemy level also takes 0.2% off the pill furnace's material.
▸ 符 Sigil Writing

Realm 6, or sooner at Vein Delving 40. One-use sigils for a hard fight (Warding 15% less taken, Thunder 15% harder, Binding, Mirror 10% sent back, Five Thunders 25% harder), Purity and Soul-Lock for the heart demon, and the Seeking Sigil: the next beast you beat on the hunt is sure to leave a piece. A sigil is an hour of work or more. Every recipe in the game lists its own numbers.
▸ 陣 Arrays

Realm 7, or sooner at Forging 40. Cut once and kept for good, placed in the cave floor: 3 places, a 4th at level 50 and a 5th at 99. Faster crafts, more experience, a sooner vault door, lighter blows in a hard fight, four more hours of work while you are away.
▸ 攜 Carrying

One elixir and one sigil go into your next warden, heart demon, vault gate or Platform challenger, and up 塔 the tower when you choose **Take up** on the floor's card. The odds on the card count them. A win spends one of whatever took part; a loss spends nothing, and the arena says which. Never the tribulation's Dragon, never a common beast. A thing made for an earlier realm is worth half as much for each realm above it.
▸ 品 Quality and 習 familiarity

Elixirs, sigils and gear come in the five gear ranks, better the further your level is above the recipe. Making the same thing earns five marks, at 25, 100, 300, 800 and 2,000 made (a pill or a sigil counts as 180, so its marks come at 1, 1, 2, 5 and 12): 10% faster; 1 make in 10 comes out twice (gear, tools and arrays are 10% faster again instead); one fewer of the first ingredient (180 fewer for a pill or a sigil); better odds of a high rank; and at the fifth never Common. Where a mark has nothing to give a recipe, it gives another 1 in 10 twice, or another 10% faster. Every recipe of a craft made 2,000 times makes that whole craft 1% faster, up to 15%. Tap the dots on a recipe to see its own five.
▸ ⏳ How long
The first levels come in minutes. About 1,550 hours of work take one craft to 99, with a rank every ten levels and a title at the top.

posts.title: 閉關 Seclusion, 塔 the Tower and 圖鑑 the Bestiary
body: **閉關 Seclusion** (fourth realm). Shut the door for eight hours and your 心魔 heart demon comes: yourself, darkened, without what you know. Beat it for a 道 point. Nine in a life, two a realm, and a loss costs nothing: it comes back in an hour. When one falls and the realm has another, the door shuts again by itself.

**擂台 The Platform** (fourth realm, on 塔 Trials). Three challengers a week, and three new ones when you break through. They stand at ×1.3, ×1.8 and ×2.5 of your own power, so the build wins them, not the number: 破甲 sunder, 破煞 bane, the tree and your class thin them as they thin any beast. The week's temper (堅 Armoured, 捷 Nimble, 癒 Mending or 狂 Frenzied) stands them ×1.3 again unless your stance or one art in your sequence answers it, and the card names the answers. A win pays a fixed sum of qi read off your realm, once each a week: the third pays three times the first, and every sum is the same for everyone in the realm, whatever they wear, whatever rate they bought and whenever they fight. The card shows each sum before you fight. A loss costs nothing, and the dice are set for the week: the same body meets the same fight, so change your stance, your arts or what you carry. Never on Auto, never driven.

**塔 The Endless Tower** (fifth realm). One floor, one beast, no top. A floor pays material and, once, a fixed sum of qi that depends on the floor alone: the same for everyone, whatever your realm, your gathering or your gear, and whenever you beat it. Every floor up to 61 pays 8.9M, so the floors you clear the day the tower opens are worth two or three layers of the fifth realm. Higher floors never pay less: floor 70 pays 69M, floor 81 832M, floor 100 38.1B, and floor 121 and every floor above it 1.29T. So there is never a reason to wait before you climb, or to buy gathering first: climb as high as you can, as soon as you can. Only 天師 Celestial Master changes it: two and a half times as much. The floor card shows what the next floor pays before you climb, and how much of your gathering that is today. Every nine floors earn a seal: +15% material from everything. A floor that falls offers 登 Next floor (R on a PC). An elixir and a sigil you carry can go up with you: choose **Take up** on the floor's card, and a won floor spends whichever took part. A pill made for your realm is worth a floor or two; the 九轉 Nine-Turn Pill at the ninth realm about five.
**圖鑑 The Bestiary** (sixth realm). A realm whose four beasts you have all 熟 Known pays a 道 point. Going back to finish an old realm pays for the tree.

posts.title: 雷池 The Tribulation, 爐 the Furnace and the Heavens
body: **雷池 The Tribulation** (ninth realm). The last layers of the whole climb. When they run out, the bar becomes the thunder pool, and a Dragon waits at the end of it. Every crossing earns a 雷印 thunder mark, and the Dragon comes back heavier every time you put it down.
**爐 The Furnace** (ninth realm). Pills, brewed from qi and material together, kept for good, with no cap. Power is what shortens a crossing.
**The Heavens.** Thunder marks open nine heavens above the summit, and each one offers a 悟道 card: one of three, your choice.
fields: ▸ The nine heavens
真仙 True Immortal · 金仙 Golden Immortal · 太乙 Supreme Unity · 大羅 Grand Veil · 准聖 Quasi-Sage · 聖人 Sage · 道祖 Dao Ancestor · 混元 Primordial Unity · 鴻蒙 The Uncarved
▸ And after that
The Tower has no top, the week turns every Monday for ever, and the 天榜 Heaven List counts thunder marks past the summit.

posts.title: 期 The week and the road
body: **期 The week** turns every Monday. It marks a beast worth double 材 material, a herb worth planting and a room of 秘境 worth reaching. It never touches the rate you gather at, so nobody falls behind for missing one.

**緣 The road.** Somebody is on the road every few hours: a child begging at a shrine, a pool with nothing living in it, and many more. One choice, and walking on is always free. Nothing is taken that you did not offer, and the road remembers what you did.

posts.title: 榜 Rankings, saves and devices
body: Your game lives on the device and the browser you play on. The app, Chrome and a PC are separate games unless you sign in.

**Joining the rankings** takes a name, then either nothing (a guest, on this device) or an email: you get a 6-digit code (and a link), and the same cultivator opens anywhere you type it. No password, ever.
Every climb on the boards is checked against real time on the server, so nobody can edit or clock their way up.
fields: ▸ The three boards

期榜 This Week: layers climbed since Monday. Everybody starts the week level, so a new player can top it in their first week. The rankings open here.
天榜 Heaven List: the furthest climb.
塔榜 The Tower: the highest floor.
▸ On the Android app
Sign in with your email like anywhere else, and type the 6-digit code from the email into the game. The app never needs to open the link.
▸ Without an account
≡ Menu → *Your save* → *Copy the save*, and on the other device *Restore from a copy*. The copy is sealed and restores exactly as it was.
▸ 盾 Fair play

Your save is sealed on your device: it reads as noise, and the game notices when one was changed by hand. That keeps the casual edit out. The real guard is the server: every climb on the boards is measured against how much real time has passed, so an edited save, a moved clock or a forged copy never reaches them. An edited save still plays on your device, because nothing is ever taken away. It is just never ranked.

body: **This week, making the game easier to play comes first.** Thank you for every post so far: most of the picture below began in this forum.

Reply here with anything that costs you a tap, a scroll or a wait you would rather not spend. Small is perfect. *"I open the gear tab every visit just to check one thing"* is exactly what we want to hear.

posts.title: 深 Deeper hunts: what do you think?
body: **This is a proposal, not the game yet.** Before we build it, we want to know what you think. Thank you, rekaris, for the posts that started it.
Right now, once you can beat a realm's warden, power stops mattering: every beast falls in one blow, so the best gear is qi gear. Deeper hunts would give power a use every day, without touching qi.
fields: 深 How it works

Win against a beast and the next **depth** of that same beast opens, at twice its power. Every depth pays **+20% 材 material**, drops gear a little more often and ranks it a little higher. It never pays qi, and losing costs nothing: every depth you won stays won. Your deepest win on each beast is your record.
性 Something to build for

From depth 3, each beast shows a trait that makes it count **eight times** its power until you answer it:
· 堅 **Armoured**: wear 體 Body pieces
· 幽 **Spectral**: wear 法 Arts pieces
· 猛 **Savage**: fight it in the 守 Guard stance
Three pieces of the right school halve it, five clear it. Your 套 loadouts make the swap one tap.
自 Auto and drives
Auto and drives hunt at the depth you leave the beast on. Going deeper is always your own choice, because that's the moment to read the trait and change your gear.
📊 What we measured

Nobody climbs the realms faster or slower because of it (within about a day, for every way of playing). A player who wears power and answers the trait gets about **half again more material and better pieces** from the same hunting.
❓ Tell us
Vote in the five quick polls below, and reply here with anything else: what you'd change, what worries you, what you'd love to find down there. Every reply is read.

threads.title: Allow one to reset seemingly permanent choices
reply: You talked me round on this one, and I'm glad you pushed back. You're right that with one save you keep growing for months, it should be able to follow your build.

Each challenger now pays a fixed sum of qi read off your realm, the same for everyone in it, whatever you wear, whatever rate you bought and whenever you fight; the week's quarry too. We measured every kind of player before and after: the ninth realm moves by less than about a day for anyone. Fought early in a realm, a challenger pays more than before; fought late, less. Thank you for spotting it.

threads.title: Consider equalizing equipment stats
reply: We measured it, as promised. A line's size never depended on the school: a power line is the same number on a Sword piece and an Arts piece. What the school decides is which line leads at full size, so a Sword piece carries about twice the power of a Fortune, Body, Artificer or Arts piece. We played every class with equal pieces (every lead drawn from the same pool): no class moved by more than about two days to the ninth realm, which is close to the noise between runs, and the Fortune, Body, Artificer and Arts schools lost the lines their own bonuses multiply. So we're keeping school-shaped pieces.

You were right about one thing that was simply badly worded: the Sword school was always a multiplier on all of your power, never added to the gear's percentage. Since this update it says so: all your power ×1.1, or ×1.2 at the full, on top of everything else. Thank you for pushing on it.

threads.title: The Tower difficulty needs to be higher
reply: Thank you, and you were right on both counts. Being taken off the rankings was our bug, not your climb: the server counted the tower's qi and the layers it bought in two different ways. It's fixed and live, so your next sync puts you back.

On the tower and on the simulations: you were right there too. We now test every balance change on real saves from the server, including yours, with a tool that asks the question you were asking: how far can this save climb without a second passing? On your save today it climbs eleven floors and a whole realm, so the tower pays for its own next floor. The fix is in testing and we'll post it with the numbers when it's ready.
